criteria.description: SortSelect in ProductListPage must read its value from FilterContext.sortBy and call FilterContext.setSortBy on change — not from any local state variable.
criteria.evidence: ProductListPage.tsx line 76: `<SortSelect value={sortBy} onChange={setSortBy} />`. sortBy and setSortBy are destructured from useFilterContext() at lines 20–21. No local sort state exists.

criteria.description: The local sort state variable (localSortBy / setLocalSortBy) must be removed from ProductListPage.
criteria.evidence: grep for 'localSortBy' in ProductListPage.tsx returned no output — the identifier does not appear anywhere in the file.

criteria.description: Selecting price-asc from the SortSelect immediately re-orders the visible product list so that the cheapest product (Jump Rope) appears first.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx 'sorts by price ascending' passed (vitest run: 3 tests in sorting.test.tsx, all passed). tests/contextMigration.test.tsx 'selecting a sort option re-orders the product list' passed (4 tests in contextMigration.test.tsx, all passed). Overall: 21 passed.

criteria.description: Selecting price-desc from the SortSelect immediately re-orders the visible product list so that Noise-Cancelling Headphones appears first and Jump Rope appears last.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx 'sorts by price descending' passed. tests/contextMigration.test.tsx 'selecting price-desc puts the most expensive product first' passed. Overall: 21/21 tests passed.

criteria.description: Selecting rating-desc from the SortSelect immediately re-orders the visible product list so that Yoga Mat appears first.
criteria.evidence: tests/sorting.test.tsx 'sorts by rating descending' passed (3 tests in sorting.test.tsx, all passed). Overall: 21/21 tests passed.

criteria.description: Clicking a 'Filter by [category]' button on a ProductCard updates FilterContext.category to that product's category, causing the list to re-filter immediately.
criteria.evidence: tests/contextMigration.test.tsx 'clicking a product category button filters the list to that category' passed — test clicks 'Filter by Electronics' button and expects results-count to read 'Showing 5 products'. 4/4 tests in contextMigration.test.tsx passed.

criteria.description: After clicking a category button, only products in that category remain visible; products from other categories are removed from the DOM.
criteria.evidence: tests/contextMigration.test.tsx 'clicking a category button hides products from other categories' passed — clicks 'Filter by Fitness', verifies Wireless Mouse absent and Yoga Mat present. 4/4 tests passed.

criteria.description: ProductCard must call useFilterContext().setCategory(product.category) directly on the category button click — not via an onCategoryClick prop.
criteria.evidence: ProductCard.tsx line 4 imports useFilterContext; line 14 destructures setCategory from useFilterContext(); lines 47–50 onClick handler: e.stopPropagation(); setCategory(product.category). grep for 'onCategoryClick' in ProductCard.tsx returned no output.

criteria.description: The onCategoryClick prop must be removed from ProductCard's Props type and from ProductList's Props type.
criteria.evidence: grep for 'onCategoryClick' in ProductCard.tsx and ProductList.tsx returned no output. ProductCard Props (lines 7–10): only product and onSelect. ProductList Props (lines 4–7): only products and onSelect.

criteria.description: The no-op onCategoryClick={() => {}} must be removed from the <ProductList> usage in ProductListPage.tsx.
criteria.evidence: grep for 'onCategoryClick' in ProductListPage.tsx returned no output. ProductListPage.tsx line 89–93: <ProductList products={filteredProducts} onSelect={setDetailProductId} /> — no onCategoryClick prop.

criteria.description: The 'Filter by [category]' button must remain rendered inside ProductCard and must remain accessible via aria-label='Filter by [category]'.
criteria.evidence: tests/contextMigration.test.tsx locates button via getByRole('button', { name: /filter by electronics/i }) and getAllByRole('button', { name: /filter by fitness/i }) — both tests pass (4/4). ProductCard.tsx line 46 confirms aria-label={`Filter by ${product.category}`}.

criteria.description: The category button click must call e.stopPropagation() so that the card's own onClick is not triggered simultaneously.
criteria.evidence: ProductCard.tsx line 48: e.stopPropagation(); inside the category button onClick handler (lines 47–50).

criteria.description: ProductList must continue to accept and forward the onSelect prop to ProductCard unchanged.
criteria.evidence: ProductList.tsx line 6: onSelect?: (id: string) => void in Props type. Line 21: onSelect={onSelect} passed to each <ProductCard>.

criteria.description: No useState holding a copy of sortBy or category may be introduced in ProductCard, ProductList, or ProductListPage as part of this change.
criteria.evidence: grep for 'useState' across all three files: ProductCard.tsx — no hits. ProductList.tsx — no hits. ProductListPage.tsx — only line 28: useState<string | null>(null) for detailProductId (not sortBy or category).
